name: Upload document
description: Uploads a user-confirmed supporting file, or a legacy .docx, on the central CKR site. Supporting files are stored in the fixed Supporting documents/ subfolder; legacy final and topic files are stored at the caller's interview-folder root. The destination is resolved server-side from the caller's identity. Do not use this action for the handover. The agent path is save_final_document, then generate_final_document with no arguments: that pair stores the approved Markdown, renders InterviewFinalSummary_{n}.docx, returns it, and advances a finalized interview to Document Generated. The docType "final" code path remains only for a legacy uploaded .docx. Do NOT use this for per-topic documents: generate_topic_document produces those from the stored summary. If recovery reports a missing topic document, call generate_topic_document with its returned topic order. The docType "topic" contract remains only for backend legacy compatibility.

inputFields.label: Document type
inputFields.description: Whether this is a legacy final .docx, an optional supporting file, or a legacy per-topic document. Do not use "final" for the handover; call save_final_document then generate_final_document. Use "supporting" for a user-confirmed attachment. For per-topic documents, including recovery, call generate_topic_document with topicOrder instead; do not use "topic" in the agent flow. The "final" and "topic" values remain for backend legacy compatibility.

inputFields.label: File
inputFields.description: The single user-confirmed file to upload. Supporting files may use their original format. A legacy final or topic file is a .docx. Do not upload the handover with this action.

inputFields.label: File name
inputFields.description: The unique file name to store, including its extension (e.g. Topic-1 Stakeholder map.docx, InterviewFinalSummary_42.docx, or Process-Checklist.pdf). Supporting files are stored under Supporting documents/; final and legacy topic files stay at the interview-folder root.
